tools.name: footprint_search_places
tools.description:
Find places in India by name and get their coordinates, to use with the other Footprint tools.

Searches about 1.2 million places down to villages. Indian village names
repeat heavily (dozens of Rampurs), so each match gives its kind (city,
town, village, locality, district, state), its state and, f

tools.name: footprint_top_areas
tools.description:
List the top ~0.7 sq km areas in an Indian state or district, ranked by building growth, building count, height or price outlook.

Use for "where is building fastest in Karnataka", "fastest-growing areas
near Pune", "tallest neighbourhoods in Goa". Only areas with enough
buildings to measure are ran

tools.name: footprint_compare_areas
tools.description:
Compare 2 to 4 areas in India side by side: price today, price outlook, building growth, how built-up, govt. rates.

Use for "Whitefield vs Gachibowli", "compare these three villages".
Returns a table with one column per area and a link to each area's page.
